body.name: Ishikawa--He--Kanamori Neyman-divergence Jensen--CMC program
body.construction: In one stratum let \(f_N(r)=r^{-1}-1\). Specialize Ishikawa--He--Kanamori's equation (14) to the Neyman generator plus the convex interval indicator representing their box model: \(\mathcal W^{\mathrm{IHK}}_{\Gamma}(P)\) contains the nonnegative \(w\) satisfying \(e_xE_P[w(Y,1)\mid Z=1]=1\), \((1-e_x)E_P[w(Y,0)\mid Z=0]=1\), \(e_xw(y,1)\in[e_x/u_x,e_x/\ell_x]\), and \((1-e_x)w(y,0)\in[(1-e_x)/(1-\ell_x),(1-e_x)/(1-u_x)]\). Set \(\mathscr R_{\mathrm{IHK},P}(w)=E_P[Zf_N(e_xw(Y,1))+(1-Z)f_N((1-e_x)w(Y,0))]\) and \(\widetilde C^{\mathrm{IHK}}_P(\tau)=\inf\{\mathscr R_{\mathrm{IHK},P}(w):w\in\mathcal W^{\mathrm{IHK}}_{\Gamma}(P),\ E_P[Zw(Y,1)Y-(1-Z)w(Y,0)Y]=\tau\}\).
